description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kalukela (Block 01), Dimbulagala D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District. (25/1200066)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land and property-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in Kalukele village under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral mapping, and title settlement procedures, which directly fits the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership claims, and land title matters.
